title: MultiModel Dev OS Registry Policy Schema
description: JSON schema defining allowed governance settings for remote registry sync, plugin installation, and path safety boundaries

allow_remote_registries.description: Master switch to enable remote registry sources. Must be true before any remote registry can be added or synced.

require_approval_for_remote_sync.description: Whether the --approved flag is required for all sync operations.

require_checksum.description: Whether SHA256 checksum verification is required for synced catalog files.

require_signature.description: Whether cryptographic signature verification is required. Placeholder for future release.

allow_untrusted_install.description: Whether plugins from untrusted registries can be installed.

allowed_write_roots.description: Directory prefixes where plugins are permitted to write files.

blocked_paths.description: Paths that are always blocked from plugin writes, regardless of allowed_write_roots.

max_plugin_files.description: Maximum number of files a single plugin can install.

max_plugin_size_kb.description: Maximum total size in kilobytes of files a single plugin can install.

max_registry_cache_size_kb.description: Maximum total cache size in kilobytes per remote registry.

allowed_file_extensions.description: File extensions permitted for plugin asset files.
